questions.def: The correct form is 'were' in the second conditional.
questions.question: If I ___ you, I would study harder.

questions.def: We use 'had' to express a wish about the present.
questions.question: I wish I ___ more time.

questions.def: Reported speech requires the past simple 'said'.
questions.question: She ___ that she was tired.

questions.def: The correct negative infinitive structure.
questions.question: He told me ___ late.

questions.def: 'If' introduces a yes/no question in reported speech.
questions.question: They asked me ___ I liked coffee.

questions.def: We say 'She told me' NOT 'She said me'.
questions.question: She said me that she was happy here.

questions.def: Reported questions use the past simple 'asked'.
questions.question: He ___ me where I lived.

questions.def: The adjective 'necessary' is required here.
questions.question: It is ___ that I need to study.

questions.def: 'To be' follows 'is said' in passive constructions.
questions.question: She is said ___ rich.

questions.def: Passive voice construction requires 'believed'.
questions.question: He is ___ to be the best.

questions.def: 'To work' completes the infinitive construction.
questions.question: They are thought ___ hard.

questions.def: 'That' introduces the clause after 'It is known'.
questions.question: It is known ___ he is honest.

questions.def: 'Need' is a stative verb and not typically used in the continuous form.
questions.question: He is needing a new computer to finish the project.

questions.def: Passive voice needs the past participle 'expected'.
questions.question: She is ___ to arrive soon.

questions.def: Present simple after 'unless' in conditional clauses.
questions.question: Unless it ___, we will go.

questions.def: Third conditional uses 'would have' + past participle.
questions.question: If I had studied, I ___ passed.

questions.def: The correct form is 'were' in the second conditional.
questions.question: If I ___ you, I wouldn't do that.

questions.def: Passive construction starts with 'It is said'.
questions.question: It ___ said that he is a good doctor.

questions.def: Infinitive after 'told' when giving instructions.
questions.question: She told him ___ the door.

questions.def: 'Told' is used when there is an object.
questions.question: She ___ me she was happy.

questions.def: The passive form is 'He is said'.
questions.question: He is ___ to be very intelligent.

questions.def: 'That' introduces the clause after 'It is believed'.
questions.question: It is believed ___ he is innocent.

questions.def: Passive voice requires the past participle 'understood'.
questions.question: It is ___ that he is tired.

questions.def: Past simple in the if-clause (second conditional).
questions.question: If she ___ harder, she would pass.

questions.def: Present simple after 'unless' (zero conditional).
questions.question: Unless you ___ now, you will be late.

questions.def: Use 'wanted' to report what she said in the past.
questions.question: She said she ___ to the party.

questions.def: Use 'would' to report a future intention in the past.
questions.question: They ___ to visit us if they have time.

questions.def: Use the past tense 'asked' to report a past question.
questions.question: He ___ me if I liked pizza.

questions.def: Use 'if' to report a yes/no question.
questions.question: She asked me ___ I had finished my work.

questions.def: Use 'was' to agree with the original tense in reported speech.
questions.question: He said he ___ going to the store.
